name: Community Service & Student Leadership
search_text: LLP - Community Service & Student Leadership: Students develop empathy and responsibility through local service projects. This program nurtures confident leaders by teaching project management, teamwork, and active citizenship.

name: General Holistic Development
search_text: General Holistic Development: This school focuses on broad-based student growth through a balanced curriculum, character building, and school-wide enrichment programs rather than a single specialized niche.

name: ICT & Media
search_text: ICT & Media: Students master digital literacy through content creation and media production. This hands-on program focuses on coding, photography, and ethical communication to navigate and shape the modern digital landscape.

name: Innovation & Enterprise
search_text: Innovation & Enterprise: Students develop a creator's mindset by identifying real-world problems and prototyping business solutions. This program emphasizes design thinking, financial literacy, and marketing to turn inventive ideas into impactful ventures.

name: Interdisciplinary
search_text: Interdisciplinary ALP: Students tackle complex, real-world issues by integrating knowledge from multiple subjects. This program fosters critical thinking and versatile problem-solving skills through collaborative, multi-perspective projects and inquiry-based learning.

name: Languages
search_text: Languages ALP: Students enhance their communication skills and cultural awareness through immersive storytelling, drama, and public speaking. This program develops confident speakers and writers who appreciate linguistic diversity and global perspectives.

name: Music & Performing Arts
search_text: LLP - Music & Performing Arts: Students build self-confidence and teamwork through creative expression. This program focuses on instrumental skills, dance, and theater, fostering an appreciation for the arts and excellence in performance.

name: Music & Performing Arts/ Visual Arts & Design
search_text: LLP - Arts & Design: Students integrate music, performance, and visual arts to foster multifaceted creativity. This program emphasizes collaborative expression, aesthetic exploration, and technical mastery across diverse artistic mediums and design platforms.

name: STEM - Game Design and Making
search_text: STEM - Game Design & Making: Students learn computational thinking and creative storytelling by building digital worlds. This hands-on program transforms gamers into creators through coding, logic, and systems thinking.

name: STEM - Health Science
search_text: STEM - Health Science: Students explore biology and nutrition to solve medical mysteries. Through experiments and inquiry, they discover how science keeps our bodies strong and healthy while developing detective-like analytical skills.

name: STEM - Material Science
search_text: STEM - Materials Science: Students investigate properties of fabrics and recyclables to engineer sustainable solutions. This hands-on program focuses on chemistry, physics, and design thinking to create innovative products and inventions.

name: STEM - Sustainability
search_text: STEM - Sustainability: Students investigate environmental challenges like climate change and waste. Through green technology and urban farming projects, they design sustainable solutions to create a resilient, eco-friendly future for their community.

name: STEM - Transportation
search_text: STEM - Transportation: Students explore the physics of flight and automotive engineering to design future mobility solutions. This hands-on program focuses on aerodynamics, energy efficiency, and prototyping to solve real-world transport challenges.

name: Sports & Outdoor Education
search_text: LLP - Sports & Outdoor Education: Students build resilience and character through physical activities and outdoor adventures. This program emphasizes teamwork, sportsmanship, and leadership skills while fostering a lifelong commitment to a healthy, active lifestyle.

name: Visual Arts & Design
search_text: LLP - Visual Arts & Design: Students explore diverse media, from traditional painting to digital design. This program encourages creative expression, aesthetic appreciation, and critical thinking through hands-on art-making and exhibition opportunities.
